extract_frames_from_video: extract frames from a video file and save them as JPEG images in a directory
run_mp4_to_frames_cli: run the command line tool to extract frames from an MP4 video file
create_frame_directory: create a directory with the video name and save extracted frames as JPEG files
process_video_with_opencv: process a video file using OpenCV to read and save individual frames
batch_extract_video_frames: batch extract all frames from a video and save them with sequential naming
